create_quantization_recipe: create a quantization recipe using QuantizationModifier with NVFP4A16 scheme for Linear layers
run_oneshot_quantization: run oneshot quantization on a pretrained causal language model with a quantization recipe
dispatch_model_offload: dispatch a quantized model to offloaded device placement for inference
generate_text_quantized: generate text from a quantized model using tokenizer input and model.generate
save_quantized_model: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk in compressed-tensors format
